newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom to launch news business services.
newsitem.headline: Telkom to launch news business services.

text.p: Indonesia's telecommunications giant PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) said on Thursday it planned to launch new services in the middle of 1997 aimed at supplying the needs of its business clients.

"We expect to launch new services based on what we call the 'Japati' or intelligent network system mainly to meet the needs of our business clients," Operations and Marketing Director Dadad Kustiwa told Reuters.
Kustiwa said the services would include toll free numbers, vote call facilities and an ability to charge calls from hotels or public telephones to their Telkom account.
He said they will also include a "unicall" service to enable firms to only use one phone number and route incoming calls to any desired destination across the country.
Another service is a "virtual net" which would give firms the ability to distribute calls nationally from one location.
Telkom also wanted to link up with other private companies to for a "premium call" service to enable firms to offer recorded information services such as plane schedules with better quality.
